name: hf-native-fec-delivery
purpose: Exercise the canonical configured short-message Reed-Solomon modes after FEC-off HELLO lost four isolated bits. Off remains the GUI-default operating-point comparator; coded modes are existing supported alternatives. Freeze RS60 bright AWGN and RS20/RS60 HFquiet8 before outcomes. Report decoded physical delivery separately from raw-clean bits, all CRC/repair/erasure counters, actual full TXenergy and increased calendar length. The multi-hour stationary Gaussian HF channel is a declared integration/comparison assumption beyond the historical short stationary validation intervals, not a realistic whole-day availability or population claim. FEC cannot defeat two consecutive scored quiet slots. No feedback, waveform retuning or receiver-threshold tuning.
